headline: Regency Centers Tops Revenue Estimates Despite Earnings Miss
summary: Regency Centers posted quarterly revenue that exceeded analyst projections, though its earnings fell short by $0.19.
why: Real estate investment trusts (REITs) are closely watched by income investors for top-line stability and property portfolio performance.

impacts.name: Regency Centers
impacts.why: Mixed quarterly results with revenue topping estimates but earnings missing.
